verdict.rationale: The project's only official SDK is its own WASI-sdk, which cross-compiles programs into WebAssembly commands that run inside a-Shell. There are no official client SDKs for its programmatic surfaces: the relay endpoint is described only in README prose, and there is no cloud API. Missing for 10: official client SDKs or libraries for the relay or Shortcuts automation surfaces, SDK documentation and reference, versioning or changelog, and independent corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: You can also cross-compile programs on your main computer using our specific WASI-sdk, and transfer the WebAssembly file to your iPad or iPhone.
